name: dsh-kdczyz-mode
description: WorkBuddy + Trae + Qoder merged into one DSH plugin: the WorkBuddy desktop account/model pool, the Trae connector and the Qoder account pool as three independent providers, plus one settings page with six tabs — two configuration tabs (XD Pool / Trae config: provider switch, account binding, model selection and its own multi-account pool) and four management/read-only tabs (accounts [WorkBuddy + Trae + Qoder, three columns] / Qoder pool / credits / usage history).
author: dhdbvcg
